core: Scavenger receptor and phosphatidylserine-guided apoptotic cell clearance
qualifier: with hyaluronan turnover, without lysosomal processing
name: Apoptotic cell recognition, scavenger receptors and hyaluronan catabolism
rationale: All members concern cell-surface recognition and scavenging of apoptotic cells, immune complexes, AGEs and hyaluronan; unlike its superset it has no lysosomal, cholesterol-storage or protein-import members, so the name stays at the recognition/engulfment step.

core: Scavenging of apoptotic cells and hyaluronan
name: Apoptotic cell and hyaluronan scavenging with lysosomal processing
rationale: Members cover scavenger-receptor and phosphatidylserine-guided clearance of apoptotic cells, immune complexes and hyaluronan; what sets it apart from the confusables is the lysosome organization, lysosomal/endosomal protein and cholesterol-storage members downstream of uptake.

core: SNARE-driven synaptic vesicle docking and fusion
name: SNARE-driven vesicle docking and fusion in transmitter release cycles
rationale: All members are docking, priming, SNARE assembly, positive regulation of Ca2+-dependent fusion or the acetylcholine/monoamine/glutamate release cycles; the release cycles distinguish it from active-zone and recycling confusables, and unlike its superset it lacks the negative-regulation members.

name: Bidirectional presynaptic control of SNARE-dependent neurotransmitter exocytosis
rationale: Members span vesicle docking, priming, SNARE assembly and transmitter release cycles, and uniquely include negative regulation of Ca2+-dependent and synaptic vesicle exocytosis plus presynaptic modulation, i.e. both enhancing and inhibitory control.

qualifier: aspartate-linked, malate-aspartate shuttle, no respiratory chain
name: TCA intermediates, aspartate metabolism and malate-aspartate shuttle
rationale: All members concern TCA intermediates (malate, oxaloacetate, 2-oxoglutarate), pyruvate handling, aspartate metabolism and the malate-aspartate shuttle; it lacks the succinate/complex II and ATP synthesis members of its superset and the PDH/CoA members of other confusables.

qualifier: coupled to complex II and ATP synthesis
name: TCA cycle, malate-aspartate shuttle and complex II-linked ATP synthesis
rationale: Members are TCA intermediates, pyruvate handling and the malate-aspartate shuttle plus succinate metabolism, succinate-to-ubiquinone electron transport and proton-motive ATP synthesis, which no confusable contains.

core: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
name: TCR second-messenger signaling, CD28 costimulation and inhibitory checkpoints
rationale: Members cover CD3/ZAP-70 TCR triggering, CD28 Vav1/PI3K costimulation, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and IL-2 output, and add second-messenger generation and Nef-modulated TCR signal transduction absent from the 15-member core, without the differentiation members of the larger theme.

qualifier: driving CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation
name: TCR-CD28 signaling driving CD8 and gamma-delta T cell differentiation
rationale: Members include the full TCR/CD28/CTLA4/BTLA signaling core and uniquely add ITK/PKC-driven T cell differentiation, CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta differentiation, IL2/IL7 network and RHOH members.

name: Core TCR-CD28 costimulatory signaling and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition
rationale: All members are proximal TCR triggering (CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70), CD28-dependent Vav1/PI3K signaling, CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition and IL-2 output; it is the shared core of its supersets, lacking their second-messenger and differentiation members.

qualifier: cytosolic and mitochondrial, t6A and wobble modification
name: Cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA charging with t6A and wobble modification
rationale: Members are cytosolic and mitochondrial tRNA aminoacylation, fidelity maintenance, threonylcarbamoyladenosine and wobble-uridine/guanine modification; t6A distinguishes it from methylation/wybutosine confusables, and it lacks its superset's tRNA splicing and selenocysteine members.

qualifier: with tRNA splicing and selenocysteine recoding
name: tRNA charging, splicing and modification with selenocysteine recoding
rationale: Members cover tRNA aminoacylation, t6A and wobble modification for fidelity, and uniquely add tRNA intron splicing, selenocysteine synthesis and translational readthrough.

name: K2P leak channels in thermal and mechanical nociception
rationale: Members are TWIK/TREK/TASK/THIK/TRESK channels, resting potential and action potential control, and detection of heat and mechanical pain stimuli; unlike its superset it lacks itch, fever and TALK members, and unlike TRP/tachykinin confusables it has the K2P channels.

name: K2P channels in nociception, itch and fever
rationale: Members are the K2P channel families including TALK, membrane and neuronal action potential control and pain/thermal detection, and uniquely add sensory perception of itch and fever generation.

core: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
name: KIT mutant resistance across seven inhibitors, including dasatinib and nilotinib
rationale: All members are KIT mutant TKI binding and resistance; beyond the imatinib/sunitinib/regorafenib core it adds dasatinib, nilotinib, masitinib and sorafenib resistance, and it lacks PDGFR, FLT3 and KIT signaling members.

core: Tyrosine kinase inhibitor resistance of KIT mutants
name: KIT mutant resistance to imatinib, sunitinib and regorafenib
rationale: All four members concern KIT mutant TKI binding and resistance restricted to the first-, second- and third-line GIST drugs, lacking the dasatinib/nilotinib/masitinib/sorafenib members of its superset and the PDGFR/FLT3 members of other confusables.

name: ERBB receptor endocytosis and multivesicular-body sorting for degradation
rationale: Members cover ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis, MVB/vacuolar sorting and EGFR, ERBB2:ERBB3 and ERBB4 downregulation plus PTEN localization; it lacks its superset's nuclear ERBB4 and PTEN stability members, the MET signaling of one confusable and the ESCRT/exosome members of others.

qualifier: with nuclear ERBB4 signaling and PTEN regulation
name: ERBB endocytic attenuation with nuclear ERBB4 and PTEN regulation
rationale: Members are ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB sorting for EGFR/ERBB downregulation, and uniquely add nuclear ERBB4 signaling, PTEN stability and activity, and protein autophosphorylation.

core: Ubiquitin-proteasome system and protein quality control
qualifier: deubiquitinase families, chain editing and selective autophagy
name: Ubiquitin chain editing, deubiquitinases, proteasome and selective autophagy
rationale: Members span E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination of many linkage types, the USP/OTU/UCH/Josephin/metalloprotease DUB families, proteasome assembly and misfolded-protein QC, and uniquely add aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and micro-autophagy, aggresome assembly and COP9 signalosome.

qualifier: atypical ubiquitin chains and degron pathways
name: Atypical ubiquitin chains, degron pathways and proteasomal quality control
rationale: Members cover K6/K11/K27/K29 and branched ubiquitination, N-end and C-end degron pathways, proteasome, ERAD regulation and misfolded-protein QC; it lacks its superset's DUB families, proteasome assembly and aggrephagy members.

qualifier: cell-intrinsic proliferation, migration and dedifferentiation control
name: Vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration and dedifferentiation control
rationale: All members regulate vascular smooth muscle cell proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation and phenotypic switching with resulting vessel remodeling; it lacks the aortic morphogenesis, matrix adhesion and endothelial activation of its superset and the cardiac and endothelial members of other confusables.

qualifier: with matrix adhesion and endothelial activation
name: Vascular smooth muscle switching with matrix adhesion and endothelial activation
rationale: Members regulate VSMC proliferation, migration, apoptosis and differentiation and vessel remodeling, and uniquely add aorta smooth muscle morphogenesis, smooth muscle cell-matrix adhesion and endothelial cell activation.

core: Viral entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral entry, protein maturation and assembly with host-pathway subversion
rationale: Members span virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry, viral protein maturation and budding-site assembly, and uniquely add SARS-CoV targeting of host signalling and junctional PDZ proteins, dengue modulation of apoptosis and host suppression of invasion.

core: Receptor-mediated viral entry and protein maturation
name: Receptor-mediated viral entry, glycoprotein maturation and budding-site assembly
rationale: Members cover virion attachment and endocytic entry, maturation of spike, E, 3a, nucleoprotein and replicase proteins and assembly at the budding site; it lacks its superset's PDZ-junction targeting, apoptosis modulation and SARS therapeutics members and lacks the genome replication/translation of other confusables.

core: Vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation and ascorbate metabolism
name: Vitamin K catabolism and gamma-carboxylation with ascorbate metabolism
rationale: Members cover vitamin K metabolism and protein gamma-carboxylation, ascorbate metabolism and vitamin E response, and uniquely add vitamin K/menaquinone catabolism and defective F9 gamma-carboxylation.

core: Gamma-carboxylated protein processing and ascorbate metabolism
qualifier: with antioxidant vitamin responses, without vitamin K catabolism
name: Gamma-carboxylated protein processing, ascorbate and antioxidant vitamin responses
rationale: Members are gamma-carboxylation, transport and propeptide removal of vitamin K-dependent proteins, ascorbate metabolism and transport, and responses to vitamins K, C and E; it lacks the vitamin K catabolism and F9 defect members of its superset and the ROS detoxification members of another confusable.
